subtitle: OpenSpec brownfield delta example
title: Signed Webhook Retries
lead: Async stakeholder sign-off for openspec/changes/webhook-retries/proposal.md before running /opsx:apply. Reuses examples/generic-plan/context.json.

questions.title: HMAC signature header & rotation window
questions.question: Which signature header format and dual-secret rotation window do existing webhook consumers require?
questions.context: proposal.md (WH-1). Fact question: breaking existing consumer verification scripts must be avoided.
questions.reason: No proposal: fact question — Business/Partner Integrations knows what existing consumers already verify.

questions.title: Retry window & backoff schedule
questions.question: For how long should failed webhook deliveries retry with exponential backoff?
questions.context: proposal.md (WH-2). Longer windows increase queue retention (Platform consulted on queue TTL).
options: Up to 24 hours (10 attempts with exponential backoff)
Up to 72 hours (15 attempts with exponential backoff)
questions.reason: 24 hours survives typical partner maintenance windows without bloating dead-letter/retry queue retention.

questions.title: Dead-letter visibility for tenant admins
questions.question: Should tenant admins see dead-lettered webhook attempts in the UI in v1?
questions.context: proposal.md (WH-3). Adding a UI table expands scope beyond backend retry delivery.
options: No UI in v1: log to ops/support only
Read-only failed delivery log in Tenant Settings
questions.reason: Keeps the OpenSpec delta strictly scoped to delivery reliability; UI can be a follow-up change.
